text: Stone has completed zone change operations on the VR 51 A-4 well to produce the "CC-1" sand. The previous completion, the "C01" sand, was isolated by pulling the 3-1/2" tubing string at 12,080' MD, setting a CIBP in the casing at 12,075' MD, and dumping 50' of cement on top of the plug, w/ ETOC at 12,025' MD. The "CC-1" sand was perforated at intervals 10,382'-10,392' MD. A CIBP was set at 10,399' MD and GP assy was set on top of CIBP. The "CC-1" sand was then gravel packed. Coil tubing was then utilized to perform an acid job on the well and jet the well with nitrogen to lift the well allowing for production to be established from the "CC-1" Sand. Operations began 03/25/2011 and ended 05/04/2011.

Permit changed to zonal isolation in lieu of full TA. Complete 10/25/20

Due to issues on the E003 well, the decision has been made to demobilize all equipment and personnel and return in 2021 to complete the TA of this well. A new APM will be submitted to fully TA the well next year.

evidence.text: The results of the operations have reclassified the well from producing oil well (POW) to oil gas lift (OGL).
The results of the operations have reclassified the well from producing oil well (POW) to oil gas lift (OGL).

text: Stone has successfully completed operations on the EW 306 A-14ST1 well to convert the well from flowing to  a gas lift well. The previously installed gas lift valves were activated and utilized to produce the well via gas lift operations.   The results of the operations have reclassified the well from producing oil well (POW) to oil gas lift (OGL).  Operations began 08/23/11 and ended 08/25/11.

evidence.text: setting a MRBP @ 16295' MD
The previous producing interval, the "LH" Sand, perfs 16310' - 16328' MD, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 16295' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the plug; ETOC @ 16245' MD.

text: Zone change operations were successfully completed on EW 306, Well A-3ST3.  Operations began on May 9, 2010 and were completed on May 25, 2010.  The previous producing interval, the "LH" Sand, perfs 16310' - 16328' MD, was isolated by setting a MRBP @ 16295' MD and dumping 50' of cmt on top of the plug; ETOC @ 16245' MD.  The "LG Lwr" Sand was then exposed to production by perforating from 16167' - 16175' MD.
